description: Fetch one agenda session with its details and a first page of attendees. Provide session_id, or path to a session URL; path alone is enough. Use list_session_attendees to page through attendees only, get_agenda to find sessions.

attendees_after.description: Attendee pagination cursor from a previous response.

event.description: B2match event URL, slug/euid, or numeric event id.

path.description: Session URL path from get_agenda; alternative to session_id.

session_id.description: Session id from get_agenda. Optional when path is set.

name: get_session
title: Get B2match session
